prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: seamless square PBR base-color texture for close-up jute cargo sacks in a realistic first-person game.
Primary request: a photographic, sharply detailed swatch of real weathered coarse burlap / hessian fabric. Show only the flat textile surface, filling the entire frame edge to edge, shot directly perpendicular with no perspective. Rough irregular twisted natural jute yarn in a clear over-under woven grid, individual fine fraying fibres and hair-like loose strands, varied thread thickness and occasional slightly darker yarn, tiny dark weave gaps. The square represents approximately 30 cm of fabric, about 85 warp threads across it, so the weave stays a credible physical scale. Restrained mottled staining from a working harbour warehouse and dusty handling, not rotten or torn. Neutral tan and oatmeal-brown fibres, low saturation, not yellow or orange. Even diffuse cross-polarised lighting: base color only, no directional light, glossy highlights, baked cast shadows, strong vignette or large folds. Intricate photographic microtexture, not a perfectly regular synthetic checker or flat noisy fill. Seamless tileable on all four edges, consistent scale and overall brightness. No sack outline, seams, border, text, label, logo, object, background, watermarks, stone, wood or cardboard. Opaque square texture, high resolution.
